description: Generate the exact SQL to fix a specific Airlock finding. Pure function — no database connection needed. Returns a ready-to-run SQL statement tailored to the table and policy names you provide. Use after get_findings or audit_supabase_rls to get a fix you can paste into a migration file.

policy_name.description: The policy name, if the finding is about a specific policy. Not needed for table-level findings like rls_disabled.

schema.description: Schema the table lives in (default: public).

table_name.description: The table the finding applies to (e.g. "profiles").

name: generate_fix
